name: loom-workspace
description: Loom-managed workspace with AI development orchestration

scripts.check:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:reuse
scripts.test: python3 -m pytest verification/model verification/test_check_pins.py verification/test_check_reuse.py verification/test_record_lib.py verification/test_core_flow.py verification/test_timing_record.py verification/test_check_regmap.py verification/test_check_roadmap.py verification/test_keyladder_formal_record.py verification/test_drbg_trng_formal_record.py verification/test_trng_if_record.py verification/test_gen_netlist_binding.py verification/test_netlist_graph_load.py verification/test_check_script_docs.py verification/test_ci_changed.py
scripts.lint: python3 -m compileall -q verification flow && git ls-files -z '*.sh' ':!.loom' ':!.claude' ':!.agents' ':!loom.sh' | xargs -0 -n1 bash -n && python3 verification/check_pins.py && python3 verification/check_regmap.py && python3 verification/check_roadmap.py && python3 verification/check_script_docs.py
